newsitem.title: UK: Allied Dunbar says new business up 19 pct.
newsitem.headline: Allied Dunbar says new business up 19 pct.

text.p: B.A.T Industries subsidiary Allied Dunbar Assurance on Thursday announced double-digit increases in both single and regular premiums in 1996.
Total new business premiums -- new regular premiums plus one tenth of single premiums -- increased 19 percent to 257.8 million stg.
New single premiums rose 24 percent to 789.9 million stg while regular premiums were 17 percent ahead at 178.8 million stg.
"These impressive results underline our competitive new business position in the UK... Growth was recorded across the whole range of products," said chief executive Steve Melcher.
"The results are particularly pleasing because we have not been seduced into gaining market share through writing loss-making new business."

Melcher said the group was confident the strong performance would continue through 1997 and that increased consumer confidence, a strong economy and improving social factors would continue to fuel market growth.
